metric_scope: Baseline/proxy metrics only; not official K6-K12 definitions.

cmd_vel.timestamp_basis: local linear interpolation between bracketing /clock messages using rosbag storage timestamps

response_proxy.encounter_detection: enter center distance <= 1.5 m; exit >= 1.8 m; minimum duration 0.5 s
response_proxy.reaction_search_window: from up to 5 s before danger entry to 3 s after closest approach; lookback is clipped at the end of the previous encounter
response_proxy.criterion: first command change persisting >= 0.25s: linear.x decreases by >= max(0.05 m/s, 3 x baseline MAD) OR abs(angular.z) increases by >= max(0.08 rad/s, 3 x baseline MAD)
response_proxy.classification_rule: TIMELY if reaction onset <= closest_approach_time_s; LATE if reaction onset is after closest approach; NO_DETECTED_RESPONSE if no qualifying command change is found
